nodes.norm_label: pr contributor checklist (single concern, no secrets, privacy impact)

nodes.label: Enforcement Guidelines (Correction, Warning, Temporary Ban, Permanent Ban)
nodes.norm_label: enforcement guidelines (correction, warning, temporary ban, permanent ban)

nodes.label: SMS Sender Allowlist (HDFCBK, VM-SBIUPI, AX-ICICIT)
nodes.rationale: Only bodies from allowlisted senders are returned to JavaScript, limiting exposure of other SMS; routing prefixes ignored; 90-day initial scan.

nodes.label: Zero-Knowledge Encrypted Backup (AES-GCM, recovery code)
nodes.rationale: Snapshot encrypted on device; server stores only ciphertext, backup ID, token hash, version and timestamps; recovery code holds ID, token and key so the server can never decrypt.

nodes.label: Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct v2.1
nodes.norm_label: contributor covenant code of conduct v2.1

nodes.label: Redact SMS Personal Details in Bug Reports
nodes.norm_label: redact sms personal details in bug reports
nodes.rationale: SMS bodies contain real amounts and account numbers; reporters must replace them with placeholders to protect privacy.

nodes.label: API Input Validation Pattern (validate before storage, timingSafeEqual)
nodes.norm_label: api input validation pattern (validate before storage, timingsafeequal)
nodes.rationale: api/src/app.ts validates ID, token and ciphertext shape before touching storage and compares secrets in constant time; new routes must follow it.

nodes.label: Conservative Parser Rule (prefer review over guessing)
nodes.norm_label: conservative parser rule (prefer review over guessing)
nodes.rationale: parser.ts should leave ambiguous messages with status 'review' rather than guess; every new pattern needs a test in mobile/test/parser.test.mjs covering a match and a false positive.

nodes.label: No Secrets in EXPO_PUBLIC_ Variables
nodes.rationale: EXPO_PUBLIC_ values are compiled into the client bundle and are therefore public.

nodes.label: Use Versioned Expo Docs, Not Training Data
nodes.norm_label: use versioned expo docs, not training data
nodes.rationale: Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release, so agents must read the expo major version and fetch matching docs.

nodes.label: Local-First Design (SQLite ledger, no analytics or sign-in)
nodes.norm_label: local-first design (sqlite ledger, no analytics or sign-in)
nodes.rationale: All ledger data stays on device in SQLite (or browser local storage on web), protected by OS sandbox; no local DB encryption, no telemetry; network used only for explicit backup.

nodes.label: Google Play READ_SMS Policy Constraint
nodes.rationale: READ_SMS is restricted on Play; a Play listing needs approval, so a pasted-SMS edition without the permission and native reader may be distributed instead.

nodes.label: Minimal SMS Permission Scope (READ_SMS only, allowlisted senders)
nodes.norm_label: minimal sms permission scope (read_sms only, allowlisted senders)

nodes.label: Treat External Input as Untrusted (idPattern, tokenPattern, ciphertextPattern)
nodes.norm_label: treat external input as untrusted (idpattern, tokenpattern, ciphertextpattern)
nodes.rationale: SMS bodies, API request bodies/params and decrypted payloads must be shape- and bounds-checked before use.

nodes.label: Zero-Knowledge Backup Server Boundary
nodes.rationale: API must only see ciphertext and token hash; changes to api/src/app.ts or mobile/src/lib/backup.ts touching this need extra review.
